P1_Header_HTML:
VAR _TotalOrders = COUNTROWS(Fact_Shipments_OTIF) VAR _TotalRev = SUM(Fact_Shipments_OTIF[Revenue_GBP]) VAR _RevM = FORMAT(_TotalRev / 1000000, "0.0") VAR _OrdersFmt = FORMAT(_TotalOrders, "#,##0") RETURN "
PAGE 1 • DELIVERY
Deliveries to Customers
Are orders arriving on time and complete? Tesco, Sainsbury's, Waitrose, M&S (" & _OrdersFmt & " Orders • £" & _RevM & "M total sales)
Cover 1. Delivery 2. Production 3. Stock
"
P1_Footer_RootCauses_HTML:
VAR _DelayedOrders = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Fact_Shipments_OTIF), Fact_Shipments_OTIF[DelayReason] <> "None") VAR _AllCauses = FILTER( ADDCOLUMNS( SUMMARIZE(Fact_Shipments_OTIF, Fact_Shipments_OTIF[DelayReason]), "@Count", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Fact_Shipments_OTIF)), "@Share", DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Fact_Shipments_OTIF)), _DelayedOrders, 0) ), Fact_Shipments_OTIF[DelayReason] <> "None" ) VAR _TopCauses = TOPN(4, _AllCauses, [@Count], DESC) VAR _CausesHTML = CONCATENATEX( _TopCauses, "" & [DelayReason] & " " & FORMAT([@Share], "0.0%") & " (" & FORMAT([@Count], "#,##0") & ")", " ", [@Count], DESC ) RETURN "
WHY DELAYS HAPPENED (" & FORMAT(_DelayedOrders, "#,##0") & "): " & _CausesHTML & "
Richmond HQ • Kevin Koshy
"
P2_Header_HTML:
VAR _TotalBatches = COUNTROWS(Fact_Production_Batches) VAR _TotalMT = SUM(Fact_Production_Batches[ActualVolume_MT]) VAR _MTFmt = FORMAT(_TotalMT, "#,##0") VAR _BatchFmt = FORMAT(_TotalBatches, "#,##0") RETURN "
PAGE 2 • PRODUCTION
Factory Production
What the factories made, how long it took, and transport temperature • " & _BatchFmt & " Batches (" & _MTFmt & " tonnes made)
Cover 1. Delivery 2. Production 3. Stock
"
P2_Footer_ColdChain_HTML:
VAR _AvgTemp = AVERAGE(Fact_Production_Batches[AvgTransportTemp_C]) VAR _Excursions = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Fact_Production_Batches), Fact_Production_Batches[ThermalExcursionFlag] = 1) VAR _BreachText = IF(COALESCE(_Excursions, 0) = 0, "All in range", FORMAT(_Excursions, "#,##0") & " out of range") VAR _TempFmt = FORMAT(_AvgTemp, "0.0") & "°C" RETURN "
TRANSPORT: Safe range: 14° to 18°C Average temp: " & _TempFmt & " " & _BreachText & " Route: Dover to Feltham
Lindt & Sprüngli UK • Richmond HQ • Kevin Koshy
"
P3_Header_HTML:
VAR _TotalHubs = COUNTROWS(Dim_DistributionHub) VAR _MaxDate = MAX(Fact_Inventory_DailySnapshot[DateKey]) VAR _Stock = CALCULATE(SUM(Fact_Inventory_DailySnapshot[StockOnHand_Cases]), Fact_Inventory_DailySnapshot[DateKey] = _MaxDate) VAR _StockFmt = FORMAT(_Stock, "#,##0") RETURN "
PAGE 3 • STOCK
Stock in Warehouses
Stock levels and space across " & _TotalHubs & " warehouses • " & _StockFmt & " cases in stock
Cover 1. Delivery 2. Production 3. Stock
"
P3_Footer_StockCover_HTML:
VAR _Bunny = CALCULATE(AVERAGE(Fact_Inventory_DailySnapshot[DaysOfSupplyCover]), Dim_Product[BrandPortfolio] = "GOLD BUNNY") VAR _Lindor = CALCULATE(AVERAGE(Fact_Inventory_DailySnapshot[DaysOfSupplyCover]), Dim_Product[BrandPortfolio] = "LINDOR") VAR _PickMix = CALCULATE(AVERAGE(Fact_Inventory_DailySnapshot[DaysOfSupplyCover]), CONTAINSSTRING(Dim_Product[BrandPortfolio], "PICK & MIX")) VAR _Excellence = CALCULATE(AVERAGE(Fact_Inventory_DailySnapshot[DaysOfSupplyCover]), Dim_Product[BrandPortfolio] = "EXCELLENCE") RETURN "
DAYS OF STOCK: GOLD BUNNY: " & FORMAT(_Bunny, "0.0") & " days LINDOR: " & FORMAT(_Lindor, "0.0") & " days PICK & MIX: " & FORMAT(_PickMix, "0.0") & " days EXCELLENCE: " & FORMAT(_Excellence, "0.0") & " days
Lindt & Sprüngli UK • Richmond HQ • Kevin Koshy
"
